export.title: Submissions export
export.description: A zip with submissions.csv and the source of each official submission (no virtual or spectating runs). One export per day.
export.notConfigured: This server has no contest data folder configured.
export.ready: The export is ready: {size}, made at {readyAt}.
export.waitUntil: You can prepare it again after {time}.

errors.export_in_progress: The export is already being prepared; wait for it to finish.
errors.export_rate_limited: An export can be prepared once a day; try again later.
errors.export_not_prepared: There is no export to download; prepare one first.

feed.title: Event feed for resolver tools
feed.description: One key per contest, used with HTTP Basic and the user name feed. The key is bound to you and stops working when you lose edit rights on the contest.

modeHints.frozen-until-release: During a freeze the feed holds only results from before the freeze until you release it to the resolver.
modeHints.live: The feed holds results during the freeze too. Choose it only when the key holder may see the real results.

feed.released: Released: the feed now holds the results during the freeze.
feed.impersonating: You are viewing as someone else: keys cannot be created, revoked or released. Use your own session.

mint.title: Create an event feed key?
mint.body: The key is shown once. An earlier key is revoked at once.
mint.label: Create key

revoke.title: Revoke the key?
revoke.body: Tools using this key are refused at once.
revoke.label: Revoke

release.title: Release results to the resolver?
release.body: The feed will hold the results of the current freeze. This cannot be undone for this freeze.
release.label: Release

reveal.title: Event feed key
reveal.once: Copy the key now: it is shown once and cannot be viewed again.
